proposed_fixes.basis: AE5 proves only two writes around the cursor with the tail paused; sustained writes during a large N-point seed leave no cursor-stability or fence-resampling rule, risking silently torn seeds.

proposed_fixes.title: Seed fence assumes repeatable snapshot S with no torn reads under concurrent writes

proposed_fixes.basis: Plan pins Skip 0.0.23 and requires an .nvmrc-satisfying Node but never pins build-vs-run Node for the optional native addon, socket-path limits, cleanup, or backoff bounds; macOS temp-dir paths and rapid restarts concretely break the supervisor.
proposed_fixes.change: Pin the host runtime contract in KTD1/U2: Node version resolution order, @skipruntime/native policy, max socket-path construction, stale-socket cleanup, bounded restart/backoff counts.
proposed_fixes.consequence_if_unchanged: Host never starts or dies on restart in CI/dev, blocking every U3-U7 gate.
proposed_fixes.title: Prebuilt-dir Unix-socket host assumes Node ABI and socket lifecycle never pinned

proposed_fixes.basis: Plan asserts one update per batch is the only atomic primitive and U1 expects exactly one notification per multi-table batch, but never proves reads block on in-flight propagation or that one batch yields exactly one room notification.
proposed_fixes.change: Add a KTD3 falsification test: concurrent read(room) during apply must never observe a partial batch, and a one-batch membership-plus-like commit must produce exactly one room notification; otherwise buffer behind a host-side generation lock.
proposed_fixes.consequence_if_unchanged: Concurrent reads flap correct/known-incorrect; AE1/U1 notification assertions flaky.
proposed_fixes.section: KTD3 — one combined input collection per commit
proposed_fixes.title: Single update atomicity assumes no torn host reads or split notifications
